title: Generalized weight decomposition of triangularizable nilpotent Lie modules
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and $H$ a nilpotent $K$-Lie algebra [def-wf-lie-algebra], where nilpotent means that its lower central series $C^1H=H$, $C^{n+1}H=[H,C^nH]$ eventually vanishes. Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space with a representation $\rho:H\to\operatorname{End}_K(V)$. Suppose each $\rho(h)$ is triangularizable over $K$, meaning that the sum of its generalized eigenspaces over eigenvalues in $K$ is $V$. For every function $\chi:H\to K$ define
$$V^{\mathrm{gen}}_\chi=\{v\in V:\ \text{for every }h\in H\text{ some }n\geq0\text{ satisfies }(\rho(h)-\chi(h)\mathrm{id})^n v=0\}.$$
The family $(V^{\mathrm{gen}}_\chi)_\chi$ is independent, spans $V$, and has only finitely many nonzero members. In particular $V=\bigoplus_{\chi:V^{\mathrm{gen}}_\chi\ne0}V^{\mathrm{gen}}_\chi$, with the empty sum allowed for $V=0$.
